CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Football.

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

5. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

6. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

   C. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rounders.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

14. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

15. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   D. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
